title: 纯前端 Todo 应用(支持增删改查 + 本地存储)
embedText: Todo 待办事项应用 任务管理 增删改查 本地存储 localStorage 三文件分离 HTML CSS JS 复选框 过滤 全部 完成 未完成
description: 三文件分离的待办事项应用,包含添加、删除、编辑、标记完成功能,使用 localStorage 持久化,支持按状态过滤(全部/未完成/已完成)

files.content: 待办事项

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}body{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;background:#f5f5f7;padding:40px 16px;color:#1d1d1f}.app{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:32px;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}h1{margin-bottom:24px}#add-form{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px}#new-todo{flex:1;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid #e5e5ea;border-radius:8px;font-size:16px}#add-form button{padding:12px 24px;background:#007aff;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}.filters{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px}.filters button{padding:6px 12px;background:transparent;border:1px solid #e5e5ea;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer}.filters button.active{background:#007aff;color:#fff;border-color:#007aff}#todo-list{list-style:none}#todo-list li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #f2f2f7}#todo-list li.done span{text-decoration:line-through;color:#8e8e93}#todo-list li span{flex:1}#todo-list li button{background:transparent;border:none;color:#ff3b30;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px}

const KEY='todos';let todos=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'[]');let filter='all';const list=document.getElementById('todo-list');const form=document.getElementById('add-form');const input=document.getElementById('new-todo');function save(){localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(todos))}function render(){list.innerHTML='';const show=todos.filter(t=>filter==='all'||(filter==='active'&&!t.done)||(filter==='done'&&t.done));show.forEach(t=>{const li=document.createElement('li');if(t.done)li.classList.add('done');li.innerHTML=`${t.text}`;list.appendChild(li)})}form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();todos.unshift({id:Date.now(),text:input.value.trim(),done:false});input.value='';save();render()});list.addEventListener('click',e=>{const id=+e.target.dataset.id||+e.target.dataset.del;if(e.target.dataset.del){todos=todos.filter(t=>t.id!==id)}else if(e.target.type==='checkbox'){const t=todos.find(t=>t.id===id);t.done=e.target.checked}save();render()});document.querySelector('.filters').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.tagName==='BUTTON'){filter=e.target.dataset.filter;document.querySelectorAll('.filters button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===e.target));render()}});render();
